patches.reason: The runtime stack fails while IrancellCoreStoreV2BuildModels calls IrancellCoreStoreV2ReadPublishedSeed during global script initialization. The published/local seed has already been completely resolved into IRANCELL_CORE_STORE_V2_BOOT_SEED before store state and models are created, so re-evaluating LOCAL_STORE_MODE and LOCAL_SEED during global initialization is unnecessary and can hit lexical initialization ordering in the flattened CDE runtime. Read from the already-normalized boot seed instead while retaining the safe seed as a defensive fallback.

Model definitions are created at top-level while the flattened CDE script is booting. They must use the already-resolved boot seed directly instead of invoking a runtime seed resolver during global evaluation. This removes the IrancellCoreStoreV2ReadPublishedSeed -> IrancellCoreStoreV2BuildModels -> global code failure path while preserving the same fixture/remote seed selected earlier by IRANCELL_CORE_STORE_V2_BOOT_SEED.
